effects: Damage over time abilities last 100% longer.
Every 5th hit of a qualifying damage over time effect triggers a Grasp of Guthix.
Grasp of Guthix deals one poison hit in a 3x3 area: 80-120% of poison ability damage plus 20-30% of maximum life points.
body.name: Tearing Thorns

assumptions: Qualifying player DoT abilities are explicitly marked in the combat ability catalogue. Devourer's Contagion is the only eligible equipment-generated DoT; poison ticks, conjure and familiar damage, converted channels, and other equipment procs are excluded.
Each of Smoke Tendrils' four self-damage occurrences advances the counter alongside its matching target hit; the target hit remains direct damage.
The duration extension applies only to marked DoT abilities and does not extend Devourer's Contagion or Smoke Tendrils. It doubles scheduled ability DoT hits without altering cadence or damage bands.
Enhanced Kerapac's wrist wraps can detonate Combust's 20 Tearing Thorns hits together; the fifth, tenth, fifteenth, and twentieth hits each trigger Grasp.
Grasp is one poison hit. The separately floored ability-damage and maximum-life terms are added before poison and AoE modifiers, poison immunity blocks the whole hit, and Big Boned can attach once.
The 3x3 target count is the resolved area-target scenario capped at 9.
